description: This file defines custom error classes and data structures related to API errors and application-level exceptions used in the backend software project.

classes.name: ApiErrorPayload
classes.description: Structured error payload returned to API clients.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: Base class for application errors (domain/service level).

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Raised when an entity cannot be found.

classes.name: ConflictError
classes.description: Raised when an operation conflicts with current state.

classes.name: DatabaseError
classes.description: Raised when database operations fail in a known way.

methods.name: ApiErrorPayload.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a new ApiErrorPayload instance with code, message, and optional details.

methods.name: AppError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an AppError with code, message, and optional details.

methods.name: NotFoundError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a NotFoundError with a message and optional details, sets code to 'NOT_FOUND'.

methods.name: ConflictError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a ConflictError with a message and optional details, sets code to 'CONFLICT'.

methods.name: DatabaseError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a DatabaseError with a message and optional details, sets code to 'DATABASE_ERROR'.
